# Diagnostics: Engine idle and stalling issues

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Check crank position sensor, verify spark advance readings, and optionally swap the fuel pump relay. [t1303]

## Tips & gotchas

- Note that replacing the intake throttle body coolant fuel heater hose connections is optional; looping them back works as an interim fix. [t1303]
- Consider swapping a generic aftermarket Fuel Pump relay with an original Nissan unit if stalling persists after other repairs. [t1303]
